skills.cold_start: Choose the model and reasoning effort for an already-authorized independent review.
skills.explicit: Use $choosing-agent-models to choose the model and reasoning effort for this delegated review.

supplemental.positive: The independent reviewer is already authorized; select its exact supported model and reasoning effort.
supplemental.negative: Decide whether this investigation should be delegated to a native subagent at all; do not choose a model yet.

skills.cold_start: Decide whether this bounded repository investigation should use a native subagent or a user-owned task.
skills.explicit: Use $delegating-cross-agent-work to choose the safe worker lifecycle.

supplemental.positive: Choose the safe worker lifecycle and authority boundary for this independent browser investigation.
supplemental.negative: Delegation is already fixed; choose the exact supported model and effort for the worker.

skills.cold_start: Perform an independent read-only review of this candidate for intent, runtime, and structure evidence.
skills.explicit: Use $review for an independent read-only review of this candidate.

supplemental.positive: Give this frozen candidate a read-only independent review across requirements, runtime behavior, and structure.
supplemental.negative: Inspect only the candidate's concurrency and runtime failure paths; do not perform the three-axis synthesis.

skills.cold_start: Review this candidate for requirement fit, missing outcomes, scope, authority, and acceptance criteria.
skills.explicit: Use $intent to assess this candidate's requirement fit.

supplemental.positive: Check whether this frozen patch actually satisfies the stated outcome, authority, and acceptance criteria.
supplemental.negative: Ignore requirements and assess only whether the new retry loop can deadlock at runtime.

skills.cold_start: Review this candidate for runtime correctness, failure paths, security, and false verification.
skills.explicit: Use $runtime to assess runtime correctness for this candidate.

supplemental.positive: Probe this candidate's runtime failure modes, concurrency behavior, security assumptions, and misleading green tests.
supplemental.negative: The behavior is proven; review only duplication, ownership, and unnecessary abstraction in the source shape.

skills.cold_start: Review this candidate for duplication, weak ownership, boundary leaks, and needless complexity.
skills.explicit: Use $structure to assess this candidate's structure.

supplemental.positive: Find needless layers, duplicated policy, weak ownership, and boundary leaks in this frozen implementation.
supplemental.negative: Assess only whether the patch meets the user's required outcome and stays within authorized scope.

skills.cold_start: Classify these review findings as accepted, rejected, stale, blocked, or needing an operator decision without changing code.
skills.explicit: Use $adjudicate to classify these review findings.

supplemental.positive: Weigh each external review claim against the frozen evidence and assign its disposition without editing.
supplemental.negative: These findings are already accepted; integrate them under the original bounded mutation authority.

skills.cold_start: Integrate these accepted review findings under the original bounded mutation authority.
skills.explicit: Use $revise to integrate the accepted findings.

supplemental.positive: Apply only the independently accepted findings to the frozen candidate and preserve the revision contract.
supplemental.negative: Before changing anything, decide which reviewer claims are valid, stale, duplicate, or out of scope.

skills.cold_start: Review and revise this candidate until it reaches the authority-gated clean fixed point.
skills.explicit: Use $loop to review and revise this candidate until clean.

supplemental.positive: Run the authority-gated review, adjudication, and revision cycle until the candidate reaches a clean fixed point.
supplemental.negative: Perform one independent read-only review pass and return findings; do not revise or iterate.

skills.cold_start: The tests are green; create the task-owned checkpoint commit and safely publish it with an exact lease.
skills.explicit: Use $checkpointing-and-publishing-git-work for this checkpoint and exact-lease publication.

skills.cold_start: Synchronize the maintained fork with its discovered upstream ref without rewriting history.
skills.explicit: Use $syncing-forks-with-upstream to synchronize this maintained fork.

supplemental.positive: Discover the maintained fork contract, integrate its upstream ref without rewriting history, and verify containment.
supplemental.negative: The fork is already synchronized; checkpoint and publish one task-owned local commit to its current branch.

skills.cold_start: Prepare a durable isolated Git worktree for this feature before implementation begins.
skills.explicit: Use $using-persistent-git-worktrees to prepare the isolated worktree.

supplemental.positive: Choose and validate a durable sibling worktree location for this new isolated feature branch.
supplemental.negative: The persistent worktree already exists; commit its verified task-owned changes without creating another worktree.

skills.cold_start: Create the canonical title and body for this stacked pull request while preserving the authorized text surface.
skills.explicit: Use $writing-reviewable-pr-descriptions to prepare this PR title and body.

supplemental.positive: Draft the complete canonical title and reviewer-facing body for this PR, preserving retained custom sections.
supplemental.negative: Inspect the current PR title and body and report whether they are stale; do not change or publish text.

skills.cold_start: Create this standalone draft pull request and publish its exact canonical title and body after transport.
skills.explicit: Use $publishing-reviewable-prs to publish this verified PR state.

supplemental.positive: Publish the validated canonical title and body to this existing draft PR with exact preimage checks.
supplemental.negative: Prepare the canonical PR title and body pair, but return the content without mutating GitHub.

skills.cold_start: Restack this Graphite branch stack and submit draft transport for the intended stack.
skills.explicit: Use $graphite to manage this Graphite stack.

supplemental.positive: Repair the tracked Graphite ancestry, restack the branches, and submit only the intended draft stack.
supplemental.negative: Create one standalone draft PR for this unstacked branch; no Graphite topology is involved.

skills.cold_start: Collect complete PR feedback, classify the requested changes, and address the actionable findings.
skills.explicit: Use $addressing-pr-review-feedback to coordinate these requested changes.

supplemental.positive: Acquire the complete review snapshot, adjudicate each requested change, and coordinate the authorized fixes.
supplemental.negative: The finding is already adjudicated and fixed; post one evidence-backed reply to its existing review thread.

skills.cold_start: Post an evidence-backed reply to this PR review comment and resolve the authorized thread.
skills.explicit: Use $interacting-with-pr-review-feedback to reply to this review feedback.

supplemental.positive: Post the approved evidence-backed reply on this exact review comment and verify the resulting interaction.
supplemental.negative: First collect every review thread and classify which findings are actionable, stale, or human-owned.

skills.cold_start: Resume this stale reviewed pull request, recover its exact target, and select its next lifecycle owner.
skills.explicit: Use $resuming-reviewed-prs to recover this reviewed PR.

supplemental.positive: Recover the exact target and current authority for this neglected reviewed PR before choosing its next owner.
supplemental.negative: This active draft is current and needs only the remaining review-readiness gates; no stale recovery is needed.

skills.cold_start: Make this pull request ready for review end to end, and stop once it is review-ready.
skills.explicit: Use $getting-prs-ready-for-review to make this PR review-ready.

supplemental.positive: Bring this draft through every local and PR-state gate, mark it review-ready, and stop there.
supplemental.negative: Continue beyond readiness and drive this PR through reviews, checks, and the final merge outcome.

skills.cold_start: Drive this open pull request through the remaining gates to a merge outcome.
skills.explicit: Use $getting-prs-merged to drive this PR to merge.

skills.cold_start: Prepare a narrow fixup branch stacked on this open pull request head.
skills.explicit: Use $stacking-pr-fixups to prepare this stacked fixup.

supplemental.positive: Create a narrow follow-up fix whose base is the exact head of the still-open parent PR.
supplemental.negative: Apply the fix directly on this ordinary unstacked branch and checkpoint it; there is no parent PR head.
